sloka: स तस्य चापनिर्घोषात् कुपितो राक्षसर्षभः।अमृष्यमाणस्तं घोषमभिदुद्राव राघवम् ।। ६.६७.१३० ।।
transliteration: sa tasya cāpanirghoṣāt kupito rākṣasarṣabhaḥ।amṛṣyamāṇastaṁ ghoṣamabhidudrāva rāghavam ।। 6.67.130 ।।

translations.english: "This king intoxicated with the smell of blood is not knowing his own people and foes and devouring both Vanaras and Rakshasas."
